:::{#def-random-experiment}
#### Random experiment

A **random experiment** is a procedure that produces exactly one outcome
out of several possible outcomes,
where which outcome it will produce is not determined in advance.

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

The possible outcomes are collected in the [sample space](#def-sample-space).
Physical procedures, such as rolling a die, and sampling procedures,
such as picking a unit from a data set without looking, are both random experiments.

:::
